data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Himayah means 'tender loving care', 'warm affection', or 'compassionate kindness'. This name is rooted in the essence of Islam, where love and compassion are emphasized. The name Himayah carries the meaning “Tender Loving Care” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Himayah usually hope their child will grow to embody tender loving care and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This is demonstrated through various acts of kindness such as giving food to the needy, visits to the sick and elderly, and providing shelter to the homeless. The significance of this name resonates strongly within Islamic communities, as it is reminiscent of Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) famous hadith encouraging Muslims to treat others with mercy and kindness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Himayah reflects Allah's infinite compassion for His creation. The Quran describes Allah as the Most Merciful and Most Compassionate (Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim), emphasizing His tender love and care for all beings. The name Himayah is a reminder for Muslims to emulate Allah's qualities, particularity towards the Creator, and towards all fellow creations. It is a call to extend grace, compassion, and kindness to everyone, treating them with love and respect as children of Allah. Thus, the name Himayah exemplifies one of the fundamental principles of Islam – to show love and compassion to all.
